_note: GitHub branch protection ruleset for a repo you push to normally. Apply via: gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/rulesets --method POST --input branch-protection/ruleset.json. WARNING: do NOT apply this to a -public-preview/-public repo whose main is force-pushed by sync-public.yml's git filter-repo step — non_fast_forward blocks that force-push and breaks the sync (hit 2026-09-02). Use ruleset-public-preview.json (deletion-only) for those instead.
